name: bg-tax-overview
description: Overview of the Bulgarian tax system for tax year 2026, in euro after the 1 January 2026 changeover. Gives the headline figures in one place: the calendar tax year, the National Revenue Agency, who is taxed on worldwide income, the flat 10% personal and corporate income tax, the 15% sole-trader rate, the 5% dividend tax, the Pillar Two 15% top-up for groups with EUR 750 million revenue, the 20% and 9% VAT rates and the EUR 51,130 registration threshold, the 2026 insurable income limits, and the main annual deadlines. Use for questions like 'how is Bulgaria taxed', 'Bulgaria tax rates 2026', 'Bulgaria flat tax' or 'when are Bulgarian returns due'. It is a map, not a computation: for the working rules use bulgaria-income-tax, bg-corporate-income-tax, bulgaria-vat-return, bulgaria-social-contributions, bulgaria-payroll, bg-transfer-pricing, bg-cross-border and bulgaria-tax-optimization.
